narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 11, 2024, at approximately 0930 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a residential construction site in Grand Rapids, Michigan, while following up on information received from the site's general contractor. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself and asked the subject about his citizenship and immigration status.
The subject stated that he is a citizen and national of Mexico and handed the agent a Mexican passport.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that on 08/22/2018 he presented his passport and a B1/B2 visa at the Laredo, Texas, port of entry and was admitted as a visitor for pleasure for six months. He stated that he never left after his authorized stay ran out in February 2019 because he found steady work.
TRAVEL:
He took a bus from Laredo to San Antonio and later moved to Michigan with a cousin.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is removable under Section 237(a)(1)(B) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that after admission as a nonimmigrant he remained in the United States for a time longer than permitted.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station and processed for a Notice to Appear.
